rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of descriptive compound with patra
second member of compound indicating petals

items.question: What specific form and attributes characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The verse identifies a sixth cakra.
This cakra is described as royal.
This cakra is described as having eight petals.
This cakra is described as possessing a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal center distinguished by eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper epithet or a general qualitative description.
Whether aṣṭa and patra are intended as a single compound split across tokens in this listing.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, with eight petals and a pericarp.
